messages:
Morgan (People Ops): Hey team — quick logistics note. The lobby door camera (unit SN: RC-2019-7G) is missing from the charging dock. I think someone borrowed it for a demo this morning. If you have it, please drop it at Front Desk or ping @Front Desk. Also: a courier left a large crate for @Jules (Acme) outside; Front Desk put it in locker #3. Finally — hot-desk sticker lottery: we have two blue desk stickers left for Monday. Drop a :seat: emoji to enter or I'll randomize at 4pm. TL;DR: camera, crate, stickers. Thanks! :cheers:

Sam J: Oof. I checked my bag — no camera. I did see Leo carrying a cam out around 9:40am though. @Leo any idea?

Front Desk: We have the crate in locker 3, tagged "Jules - ACME". Also found a small Pelican case labeled "LobbyCam". Holding it at the desk behind the monitor.

Leo (Facilities): Yep — that was me. Borrowed it for the lobby demo and got pulled into another meeting. Sorry, my bad. I'll swing by now to drop it off.

Maya (Eng): If anyone took the mount too, can you leave it in the AV cabinet (room B2)? The mount has a velcro strap with white tape on it.

Jules: Thanks for the crate note — I'm out until 5pm. @Front Desk can we schedule pickup for tomorrow morning? Would prefer not to sign for it today. :pray: 

deliveries-bot: Package 'ACME Demo Crate' delivered by CourierX at 10:12. Left at lobby. Locker 3 assigned. Tracking: CX-998877

ops-bot: Badge log snippet for 2026-03-23 09:38 — badge_id: 7654, name: 'Jules A.' scanned at front-desk. ```2026-03-23T09:38 badge=7654 name=Jules location=front-desk```

Morgan (People Ops): Cool — Leo if you can return it before 11 that'd be ideal. For the sticker lottery, drop a :seat: if you want in. If we get multiple folks we'll randomize at 4pm.

Sam J: :seat: count me in

Maya (Eng): :seat: (if it's near a window please)

Leo (Facilities): Camera returned to front desk at 10:05. Left a sticky note on the Pelican case with my initials. :white_check_mark:

Front Desk: Confirmed — camera back in dock and charger connected. Crate secured in locker 3. Sticker update: only two :blue_square: remaining.

Jules: Huge thanks everyone! Also FYI the visitor asked about the quiet demo booth; I told them it's reserved for demos today. :coffee:

Morgan (People Ops): Great — I'll run the sticker draw at 16:00 and post results in #lunch-plans. Appreciate the quick responses!
